## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Sayings-Record of Chán Master Huáihǎi Yuánzhào* — a one-juan Southern-Sòng *yǔlù* of **Huáihǎi Yuánzhào** 淮海原肇 (1189–1275), Línjì-lineage master. Compiled by **27 attendant-disciples** (*shìzhě ménrén* 侍者門人) — an unusually large editorial team: lead-editor [Shírén](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AF%A6%E4%BB%81) and [Zōngwén](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%97%E6%96%87), alongside 法奇, 守愿, 行佑, 了元, 善之, 淨證, 法從, 紹熏, 普璋, 文煥, 淨伏, 慧行, 文謙, 正因, 法恩, 德紀, 可能, 持志, 覺孫, 惟康, 宗和, 如止, 有智, 慧雲, 若舟 (all listed in the catalog; only the two lead-editors wikilinked in frontmatter to keep it manageable).

One-juan Southern-Sòng Chán *yǔlù*, X69 n1370.

Dating: *notBefore* c. 1200; *notAfter* c. 1280.
